These grants cover the original contributions only. They do not license
manufacturer drawings, photographs, CAD or other third-party material.
No manufacturer faces, vertices, BREP, mesh or source CAD are included or
read by this producer. A small set of functional numerical observations
from retained CAD is recorded as CAD-reference measurement, separately
from inferred forming dimensions and physical specimen measurements.

Molex and CLIK-Mate are their respective owner's names/marks. Factual
reference housings: 5025780200, 5025780300 and 5025780400. They identify
the comparison family, not a verified fitted machine SKU.

Primary factual references, retained under their original terms:
https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/series-chart/502578
https://www.molex.com/content/dam/molex/molex-dot-com/products/automated/en-us/applicationspecificationspdf/502/502578/AS-502578-001-001.pdf?inline=
Application sheets 9/14/19/20/21 support contact/formed-barrel structure,
axial insertion, tab orientation and retention recovery. Illustrations do
not supply an exact seating datum or establish fitted terminal SKU.
5025790000-SD sheet 1 and 5034290000-SD sheet 1 supply terminal-family
overall/contact lengths and insulation ranges. No drawing image or
manufacturer geometry is redistributed with this contribution.
